about: Test data for the news channel: an English excerpt modelled on src/show/dev/fixtures/zoo-badger-demo (one 'allegedly' added), a Spanish translation and its literal back-translation, all written 2026-11-24 by a Claude session (wave 3). NOT blind: the same session wrote the English, the Spanish and this back-translation.

title.text: FixtureSwap reporta un drenaje de US$ 4,2 millones (en desarrollo) - extracto de prueba
title.bt: FixtureSwap reports a drain of US$ 4.2 million (in development/developing) - test excerpt

s01.narration.text: Una clave filtrada. US$ 4,2 millones perdidos, según FixtureSwap [src:src-wire]. Buenos días.
s01.narration.bt: A leaked key. US$ 4.2 million lost, according to FixtureSwap [src:src-wire]. Good morning.

s02.narration.text: FixtureSwap dice que unos atacantes drenaron US$ 4,2 millones de sus pools de liquidez [src:src-wire]. La empresa dice que la investigación sigue en curso, y que las cifras podrían cambiar [src:src-pm].
s02.narration.bt: FixtureSwap says that some attackers drained US$ 4.2 million from its liquidity pools [src:src-wire]. The company says that the investigation continues ongoing, and that the figures could change [src:src-pm].

s02.onScreen.title.text: FixtureSwap reporta un drenaje de US$ 4,2 millones
s02.onScreen.title.bt: FixtureSwap reports a drain of US$ 4.2 million

s03.narration.text: Según la revisión preliminar de FixtureSwap, se usó una clave de despliegue comprometida para actualizar el contrato del pool [src:src-pm]. Example Security Lab dice que luego los fondos pasaron a una dirección que acababa de recibir fondos, y cruzaron un puente [src:src-lab].
s03.narration.bt: According to the preliminary review of FixtureSwap, a compromised deployment key was used to update the contract of the pool [src:src-pm]. Example Security Lab says that then the funds passed to an address that had just received funds, and crossed a bridge [src:src-lab].

s04.narration.text: La estafa de la semana: falso soporte de billeteras. Example Security Lab advierte que cuentas que se hacen pasar por soporte supuestamente piden a los usuarios su frase de recuperación [src:src-lab2]. El soporte real nunca la pide.
s04.narration.bt: The scam of the week: fake wallet support. Example Security Lab warns that accounts that pretend to be support supposedly ask the users for their recovery phrase [src:src-lab2]. The real support never asks for it.

s04.onScreen.fix.text: Nunca la compartas. El soporte real nunca la pide.
s04.onScreen.fix.bt: Never share it. The real support never asks for it.

s05.narration.text: El consejo de Zoo, para equipos: guarden las claves de actualización en una multifirma con un retraso de tiempo, para que una sola clave filtrada no pueda cambiar un contrato al instante.
s05.narration.bt: Zoo's advice, for teams: keep the update keys in a multisignature with a time delay, so that a single leaked key cannot change a contract instantly.

s05.onScreen.fix.text: Guarden las claves de actualización en una multifirma con retraso de tiempo
s05.onScreen.fix.bt: Keep the update keys in a multisignature with a time delay
